product_overview: A static, dark-themed technical blog built with Astro (SSG) that serves MDX-based posts with pagination, tag/category filtering, client-side search (Pagefind), RSS and sitemap generation, and a newsletter subscription form integrated with an external provider.
core_goals: Serve a performant, SEO-optimized static blog using Astro with MDX content collections.
Provide paginated listings, individual post pages with rich metadata and structured data, and filters by category and tag.
Enable client-side search (Pagefind) and a simple newsletter subscription flow while keeping zero JS by default.
Expose site-wide RSS and sitemap feeds, and meet accessibility and Lighthouse performance targets.

features.name: Blog post listing (Homepage & /blog pagination)
features.description: Homepage and /blog pages present paginated lists of published posts ordered by date descending (6 on homepage, 9 on /blog pages).
user_flows: GET / -> 200 OK with HTML containing 6 latest published posts sorted by date desc and readingTime metadata for each post
GET /blog -> 200 OK with HTML containing first page of 9 posts -> GET /blog/2 -> 200 OK with HTML containing page 2 posts
GET /blog/999 -> 404 Not Found when requested page number is out of range or pagination artifact missing

features.name: Individual post page
features.description: Renders each MDX article at semantic URL with title, description, cover image, computed reading time, category, tags, and prev/next navigation plus JSON-LD Article schema.
user_flows: GET /blog/2026/04/seo-en-2026 -> 200 OK with HTML including title, description, cover image, readingTime, category and tags, prev/next links and JSON-LD Article schema
GET /blog/2026/04/nonexistent-slug -> 404 Not Found when the slug does not map to a published post

features.name: Category filtering
features.description: Filter posts by category via semantic routes (/categoria/[slug]) and show only posts that belong to the requested category.
user_flows: GET /categoria/frontend -> 200 OK with HTML listing only posts that belong to the 'frontend' category
GET /categoria/unknown-category -> 200 OK with HTML containing a 'No posts found' message when no posts are associated with the category

features.name: Tag filtering and Tag Cloud
features.description: Filter posts by tag via /tag/[slug] and display a weighted tag cloud in the sidebar based on tag counts.
user_flows: GET / -> 200 OK with HTML containing Tag Cloud including tag names and counts as links
GET /tag/astro -> 200 OK with HTML listing posts that include the 'astro' tag
GET /tag/unused-tag -> 200 OK with HTML showing 'No posts found' when a tag has no published posts

features.name: Blog archive
features.description: Chronological index of all posts grouped by year at /blog/archivo.
user_flows: GET /blog/archivo -> 200 OK with HTML grouping all published posts by year (chronological index)
GET /blog/archivo -> 500 Internal Server Error when the build-time archive index generation fails or artifact is missing

features.name: SEO metadata and structured data
features.description: Per-page meta tags (title, description), Open Graph, Twitter Card, canonical URL and JSON-LD Article schema included in each post and relevant pages.
user_flows: GET /blog/2026/04/seo-en-2026 -> 200 OK with HTML containing meta title, meta description, og:image, twitter:card, canonical link and JSON-LD Article schema
GET /blog/bad-frontmatter -> 200 OK but HTML is missing og:image and canonical when required frontmatter fields are absent (build warning/error logged)

features.name: RSS Feed
features.description: RSS feed at /rss.xml containing all published posts for subscribers and feed readers.
user_flows: GET /rss.xml -> 200 OK with application/rss+xml containing entries for all published posts
GET /rss.xml -> 500 Internal Server Error when feed generation failed during build or artifact is missing

features.name: Sitemap
features.description: Automatically generated sitemap at /sitemap-index.xml referencing site pages and post URLs.
user_flows: GET /sitemap-index.xml -> 200 OK with XML sitemap including homepage, blog index, post URLs and archive/category/tag pages
GET /sitemap-index.xml -> 500 Internal Server Error if sitemap generation failed during the build

features.name: Newsletter subscription form
features.description: Email subscription form rendered in the footer (and optionally in posts) with client-side email validation; submissions are sent to an external provider or serverless endpoint.
user_flows: POST /api/newsletter with valid email=user@example.com -> 200 OK (or 202 Accepted) when external provider accepts subscription
POST /api/newsletter with invalid-email -> 400 Bad Request when client-side validation is bypassed and server/provider rejects payload

features.name: Pagefind client-side search
features.description: Client-side search using Pagefind: the Pagefind script and index are lazy-loaded when the user opens search from the header.
user_flows: GET /assets/pagefind.js -> 200 OK when the search widget is toggled and the Pagefind JS is lazy-loaded -> GET /_pagefind/index.json -> 200 OK with static search index used to return search results client-side
GET /assets/pagefind.js in dev mode -> 200 OK and the app shows an informative dev-mode message when the index is not present

features.name: Reading time calculation
features.description: Automatic reading time calculation at 200 wpm, surfaced on post cards and individual posts.
user_flows: GET / -> 200 OK with HTML where each PostCard includes a readingTime value computed at 200 wpm
GET /blog/broken-post -> 200 OK but readingTime missing or zero when the post content is malformed (build-time warning)

features.name: Dark theme UI and responsive layout
features.description: Mobile-first responsive design in a dark theme (no theme toggle) using Tailwind CSS with a purple accent, sticky header and accessible components.
user_flows: GET / -> 200 OK with HTML that includes theme markup (dark mode classes) and references to compiled CSS
GET /assets/styles.css -> 200 OK when the compiled Tailwind CSS is requested; if stylesheet is missing GET /assets/styles.css -> 404 Not Found causing fallback unstyled content
